in_hebrew.name: לֵוִי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Joab, from the Hebrew root לָוָא (lāwā), meaning 'attached', 'joined', 'united'. The name Levey is derived from the Hebrew name Leah or Levi, which is a common name in the Bible, particularly for members of the Levite tribe.

in_greek.name: Λευι
in_greek.long_meaning: Levi, derived from the Hebrew name לֵוִי (lēwī), meaning 'Joab, Levite'. In the New Testament, the name Levey could be interpreted as a Hellenized form of the Hebrew name Levi.

in_latin.name: Levi
in_latin.long_meaning: Levi, derived from the Hebrew name לֵוִי (lēwī), meaning 'Joab, Levite'. In Latin texts, the name Levey may be used interchangeably with the name Levi.
